exposure.input_policy: Header+prefix+open+note+synthetic close; no true future in writer CE. Labels were selected using observed TRAIN futures.

training_cost.qualification: Actual SFT supervision/cold/checkpoint costs remain included; not an end-to-end speed comparison.

new_reader_cost.qualification: Eight score processes run concurrently on a shared host; do not sum reused note generation over reader cells or infer training speed.

interpretation: Both adapted-reader cells are harmful versus empty/other/shuffled controls. Adapted raw likelihood also declines. Positive filler contrasts alone do not establish useful content or reader-writer coadaptation.
limitations: Secondary development diagnostic, not replacement of the fixed-B0 negative primary or an official final test.
One trained writer checkpoint/seed; conditional document intervals do not quantify training-seed variation.
Full quartile diagnostics and all raw score rows are retained in the private verified archive.
All notes retained, including63 writer caps versus45 B0 caps; no resampling, failure dropping or best-checkpoint selection.
Reader adaptation raw drift is reported, not required to equal B0.
Shared-host parallel score walls and reused cache state do not establish throughput improvement.
